title: Zumenart Purimas Surabaya
description_id: Leg akhir (final stop) dari Tour de Java. Menghadirkan pameran seni kolaboratif perupa muda Faith Shamayim bersama Gen Z.
description_en: Final leg stop of the Tour de Java. Featuring collaborative art exhibition by young artist Faith Shamayim and Gen Z.
review_id: Antusiasme luar biasa dari generasi muda seni Rupa Surabaya dengan diskusi kritis seputar cara orang Bali merespons pendatang asing.
review_en: Tremendous Gen Z enthusiasm exploring how Balinese society responds to foreign cultural influences.
